title: Plugin actions + link handlers
description: herdr-plugin.toml actions with pane/workspace contexts, backed by tk herd subcommands: "Retry tick" (reopen + respawn via reconcile plan semantics — never a second branch), "Open worktree" (new pane at the worktree cwd, --no-focus rules), "Collect tick" (runs tk herd collect and shows the verdict). Link handler: tick-id pattern in pane text opens the dashboard focused on that tick. Every action must target only run-created resources and respect the focus etiquette. Live-verify each action from the herdr UI.
